{"metadata":{"description":"分享任意段落的 DSH 对话","id":"gh:1332322629","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-conversation-share","slug":"bill9109/dsh-conversation-share","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-conversation-share — Share a range of a DSH conversation as an image"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**Install:** `dsh plugin --profile web add github:omdsh-dev/dsh-conversation-share`"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Render a selected range of a DeepSeek Harness conversation into a PNG long image with a branded fo"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"oter, ready to share.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Conversation history lives inside the DSH Web UI, and sharing a meaningful part of it usually means "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"screenshots spliced by hand — cropped, misaligned, with no brand or context. This plugin lets you pi"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ck an exact range of a conversation with two draggable, magnetically snapping markers and render it "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"into a single polished PNG long image with a DeepSeek Harness branded footer."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Share capsule** to the left of the Session log button in the top-right corner (same style as log"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"; clicking activates a blue highlight, with `[Cancel][Confirm]` expanding to its left)
- **Two dragg"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"able range markers** (horizontal labels: "Start here" / "End here") with magnetic snapping
- Snap po"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ints = semantic message rows + markdown blocks (p/pre/ul/li/table/headings) + visual boxes (code blo"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"cks/cards) + content-level buttons (artifact file chips) + every text line inside paragraphs
- The s"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"tart handle snaps to an element's **top edge**, the end handle to its **bottom edge**; the two handl"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"es cannot cross
- Snap hint = light blue translucent rounded-rect fill (flat style)
- **Scrolling mo"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"del**: handles follow the pointer 1:1 within the viewport without scrolling; only when the pointer e"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"nters the top/bottom edge zones (64px) does the page scroll (clamped penetration depth, frame-rate i"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"ndependent), stopping when it leaves; clicking does not scroll (a real drag of ≥8px is required)
- *"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"*Capture**: 40pt theme-background padding (symmetric on all sides) + a DeepSeek Harness brand icon a"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"t the bottom (with the BETA badge text); extra-long content is rendered in chunks and stitched toget"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"her to bypass the canvas height limit
- **Preview modal**: image width adapts, vertical scroll to re"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"view, download PNG, copy image"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. Click the share capsule next to the Session log button in the top-right corner; it activates (blu"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"e highlight) and the `[Cancel][Confirm]` controls appear
2. Drag the two range markers to select the"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" conversation range — they snap to message rows, markdown blocks, and line-level text; the start han"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"dle snaps to a top edge, the end handle to a bottom edge
3. Click **Confirm** to render the selectio"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"n into a PNG long image (extra-long content is chunked and stitched automatically)
4. Review the res"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ult in the preview modal: download the PNG or copy the image to the clipboard"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Install into the `web` profile with the standard `dsh plugin` mechanism (no source changes, no manua"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"l package.json edits):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Internally the command runs `pnpm add <spec>` in the profile directory and automatically appends pac"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"kages that declare `dsh.bundle` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The repository ships its build output (`li"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"b/`), so no consumer-side build is needed."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"After installing, **restart web** and **hard-refresh** the browser (Cmd+Shift+R) — old tabs do not l"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"*restart web** and **hard-refresh** the browser (Cmd+Shift+R) — old tabs do not load the new bundle."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Hot install (no restart)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`dsh plugin add` appends the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles`, which is composed once at boot, so it "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"needs a **restart web**.
